name: Community Health Evidence Brief
problem: Community-health planning and grant work requires many public indicators assembled into one sourced, understandable picture.
inputs: Geography, planning/grant question, target population where appropriate and requested public indicators.
outputs: Geography-specific public-health evidence brief with indicator provenance, gaps, comparisons and uncertainty.
pricing: Current hypothesis $250-$2,500 per brief; not auto-quotable yet.
confirmation: Public-health research/education only, not medical advice or diagnosis. Paid scope requires explicit confirmation.
invocation_status: Discoverable capability; brief-specific source verification required before fulfillment.
